newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK long govt papers yield lower in line with U.S.
newsitem.headline: HK long govt papers yield lower in line with U.S.

text.p: Long-dated Hong Kong government papers yielded lower on Wednesday following overnight losses in U.S. treasury yields, dealers said.
Yields of 10-year Exchange Fund notes eased to 7.18 percent from 7.26 at Tuesday's midsession.
Seven-year notes yielded 6.9 percent versus 6.97, and five-year notes yielded 6.62 percent versus 6.69.
Yields of three-year notes sagged to 6.09 percent from 6.14.
Short-dated one-week Exchange Fund bills yielded 4.9 percent, little changed from the previous 4.88.
Interbank rates were steady. Overnight cash traded at 3/16 1/8 percent versus 5-5/32 9/16. Three-month carried an interest rate of 5-1/2 7/16 percent versus 5-5/8 9/16.
